chunks: My father narrated to me (may Allah have mercy on him) from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Ibn Faddal, from Abdillah ibn Muskān, from Abū 'Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever visits the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him), Allah will record him among the 'Illīyyīn.

key_terms.عِلِّيِّينَ: A high rank in Paradise, mentioned in the Quran
key_terms.قَبْرُ الْحُسَيْنِ: The grave of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn (a.s.)?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* elevates the visitation of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) to a cosmic act of worship, linking the physical pilgrimage to the spiritual elevation of the soul. By recording the visitor among the *'Illīyyīn*, it signifies a permanent, exalted station in the highest registers of Paradise, reflecting the unique intercessory status of the Ahl al-Bayt. This connects the earthly act of Ziyarah with the ultimate divine proximity, reinforcing the theological importance of the Imams as the means of drawing near to Allah.
